-r requirements.txt

# Test runner.
pytest==8.4.2

# Validates every JSON file against its generated JSON Schema.
jsonschema==4.25.1

# Reads back the PDFs we generate, to prove they are parseable.
pdfplumber==0.11.7

# Linting / formatting, so contributed generators stay readable.
ruff==0.13.1
# Used by the documentation examples, and by the test that runs them.
